content:
[0] While CarPlay supports hundreds of apps, Apple Weather is not one of them. The good news is that starting today, The Weather Channel's Storm Radar iPhone app now supports CarPlay.

[1] Storm Radar is part of the growing list of weather apps available on CarPlay.

[2] The Weather Channel has spent this year making Storm Radar a top-tier app on Apple platforms.

[3] AI-powered weather forecasts were previously added to the iPhone and iPad versions, followed by an Apple Watch version.

[4] Today's new update takes things further with a standalone app designed specifically for CarPlay. Here's a look at the app's interface:

[5] The CarPlay version of Storm Radar shows a map of your current location. You can toggle between satellite and default map backgrounds. Data layers include radar, cloud cover, and precipitation information.

[6] Navigation is also a key feature of this CarPlay app. Storm Radar displays your current weather conditions side-by-side with the expected weather at your destination and the estimated time of arrival.

[7] The Weather Channel added that CarPlay support includes "automatic rerouting and weather alerts along your route that update as you drive."

[8] Today's Storm Radar update also brings new home screen widgets, a redesigned Apple Watch app, and more. You can check out the full release notes for version 4.0.19 on the App Store.
